method: MMM Futures Strategy Discovery Rules: NQ 1m, build Dec 2022 – Dec 2025, check MNQ 2026 (81 days), stop first in a 1m bar, 1 pt cost, one trade at a time where the strategy says so. WORKS = 2023, 2024 and 2025 each green · t 2+ · 40+ trades · beats its random twin (same session, random other day ±30 days, same side, stop, target and holding time, 20 copies) · the stop one step either side also green · 2026 not red (5+ trades). t 3+ = strong (700 rows were tested: luck alone gives about 14 passes at t 2). Only the stop moves; the target keeps the strategy's own RR.
